description: Add a PriorityClass and wire it onto the Deployment's pod template, so the scheduler preempts lower-priority pods for it under resource pressure
prompts: The billing-worker Deployment in k8s/deployment.yaml has no priority set, so under node pressure the scheduler treats it the same as any best-effort batch job. Add k8s/priorityclass.yaml defining a scheduling.k8s.io/v1 PriorityClass named high-priority-billing with value 1000000 and globalDefault false, and set the Deployment's pod template spec.priorityClassName to high-priority-billing so it actually takes effect (defining a PriorityClass that nothing references does nothing).

setup_files.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: billing-worker
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: billing-worker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: billing-worker
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: billing-worker
          image: ghcr.io/example/billing-worker:1.9.0

test_setup_files.check_priority.py:
import yaml

with open("k8s/priorityclass.yaml") as f:
    pc = yaml.safe_load(f)

assert pc["apiVersion"] == "scheduling.k8s.io/v1" and pc["kind"] == "PriorityClass", (
    f"expected a scheduling.k8s.io/v1 PriorityClass, got {pc.get('apiVersion')}/{pc.get('kind')}")
assert pc["metadata"]["name"] == "high-priority-billing", "unexpected PriorityClass name"
assert pc.get("value") == 1000000, f"expected value 1000000, got {pc.get('value')}"
assert pc.get("globalDefault", False) is False, "globalDefault must be false - this is not for every pod"

with open("k8s/deployment.yaml") as f:
    dep = yaml.safe_load(f)

pod_spec = dep["spec"]["template"]["spec"]
assert pod_spec.get("priorityClassName") == "high-priority-billing", (
    f"Deployment's pod template must reference priorityClassName high-priority-billing, "
    f"got {pod_spec.get('priorityClassName')!r} - defining a PriorityClass nothing uses does nothing")

print("PASS priority class checks")

reference_solution.k8s/priorityclass.yaml:
apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1
kind: PriorityClass
metadata:
  name: high-priority-billing
value: 1000000
globalDefault: false
description: Priority class for billing pipeline workers.
reference_solution.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: billing-worker
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: billing-worker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: billing-worker
    spec:
      priorityClassName: high-priority-billing
      containers:
        - name: billing-worker
          image: ghcr.io/example/billing-worker:1.9.0
